accepted_limitations: Bounded candidate implementations with explicit target-specific schemas and checks; not a production cutover.
Illustrative graph support nodes do not authenticate people, runs, receipts, grants or evidence.
Profiles contain proposed parameters and evaluate supplied assertions; no real policy activation or action authorization.
Derived views are complete only relative to supplied inputs; no global registry or semantic truth claims.
Thirty-two inherited source-lineage residues and the existing D53 layout exception remain explicit.
next_step: Apply dependency-aware registry admission and integration using these approved exact contracts; preserve candidate Definition dependencies and fixture-only limitations. This review does not establish admission of earlier candidate meanings.
history_policy: This additive decision supersedes pending owner review for the exact 83 targets. Frozen candidate files and receipts remain unchanged; approval does not relabel their construction evidence as admission.
